title: mariscus manimae
intro: Mariscus manimae, commonly known as the Indian club moss or Lycopodiopsida, is a type of plant that belongs to the Lycopodiaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mariscus manimae include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antitumor activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include lignans, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
